mapper.select: select p.board_id, p.post_id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.created_at, u.nickname, b.board_name as tags, COALESCE(COUNT(c.comment_id), 0) as comment_count from post p join user u on p.user_id = u.user_id join board b on p.board_id = b.board_id left join comment c on p.board_id = c.board_id and p.post_id = c.post_id and c.is_deleted = 0 group by p.board_id, p.post_id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.created_at, u.nickname, b.board_name order by p.created_at desc

select p.board_id, p.post_id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.created_at, u.nickname, b.board_name as tags, COALESCE(COUNT(c.comment_id), 0) as comment_count from post p join user u on p.user_id = u.user_id join board b on p.board_id = b.board_id left join comment c on p.board_id = c.board_id and p.post_id = c.post_id and c.is_deleted = 0 group by p.board_id, p.post_id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.created_at, u.nickname, b.board_name order by p.created_at desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}
select count(distinct p.board_id, p.post_id) from post p
